 About This Dataset
 The battle for YouTube's most subscribed channel is one of the internet's greatest ongoing competitions. This bar chart race tracks the top channels from 2014 to 2024, capturing legendary rivalries and surprise overtakes.
 Relive the epic PewDiePie vs T-Series battle, watch MrBeast's meteoric rise to the top, and see how music channels like T-Series and Cocomelon changed the game. The visualization captures each channel's subscriber count in millions.
 YouTube subscriber races are some of the most shared data visualizations online — perfect for reaching the platform's massive audience of creators and fans.

 Key Facts
 MrBeast surpassed T-Series to become #1 most subscribed individual creator

 T-Series was the first channel to reach 200M subscribers

 PewDiePie held #1 for nearly a decade before being overtaken

 Music and kids' content channels dominate the top 10
